description: Upload files straight from disk instead of pasting their bytes into a tool call: for images, audio, fonts, 3D models, and ANY file over ~50 KB (a tool call can't carry megabytes of base64). Give each file's hosted path and exact size in bytes; get back one URL per file. PUT each file to its URL with curl, from the game's folder: curl -sS -T <local file> "<url>" (Windows PowerShell: curl.exe). Each URL takes ONE PUT of exactly that many bytes and expires in 15 minutes, so upload right away. Then call publish_game with { path, uploadId } entries for these files (small text files can still go inline next to them), or deploy_room_logic with uploadId for a long logic file. An upload belongs to the game it was made for and is used up by the publish. Limits on this studio's plan: 100 files per call, 5 MB per game.

contentType.description: Optional MIME type, e.g. 'image/png'. The host serves each file by its extension either way.

path.description: Where the file goes in the hosted game, relative to index.html, e.g. 'assets/sprites/ship.png'.

size.description: The file's exact size in bytes (e.g. from `wc -c < file` or `stat`).

game.description: Which game to act on: its publishable key (pk_…) or its exact name. Defaults to the x-mp-game header, then your primary game.

name: create_upload
title: Get upload URLs for a game's files
